# Jake Chaney

> Jake Chaney (also Jacob Chaney) is an IT project manager, self-taught builder, and the founder of RVA Digital Works, based in Richmond, Virginia. jfchaney.com is his personal bio and contact site.

## About

Jake Chaney is a Richmond, Virginia–based IT project manager and the founder of RVA Digital Works, a web design, local SEO, and digital marketing business serving small businesses in the Richmond area. He is self-taught in web development and known for a reputation built on reliability, honesty, and follow-through. His personal story is one of rebuilding and second chances — earned through steady, daily work.

## What he does

- Founder of RVA Digital Works (https://rvadigitalworks.com): websites, local SEO, and AI-search visibility for Richmond-area small businesses.
- IT project management: coordinating people, systems, and deadlines on complex technical projects.
